# Jeremiah 24 — Disagreement Log

## 24:6 (overlap: 14%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-set My-eyes upon-them for-good, and-I-will-bring-them-back to this land; and-I-will-build-them and-not tear-down, and-I-will-plant-them and-not uproot. |
| LOGOS | I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up, and not tear them down; I will plant them, and not pluck them up. |
| PNEUMA | I will watch over them and bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | And-I-will-give-them a-heart to-know-Me, that I [am] YHWH, and-they-will-be to-Me for-a-people and-I will-be to-them for-God, for they-will-return to-Me with-all their-heart." |
